items.narrative:
New patient with <ref id="dx_ckd">CKD G3b A2</ref>, with <ref id="dx_dm">type 2 diabetes since 2017</ref> and <ref id="dx_htn">hypertension since 2014</ref>.

eGFR 42 today, K 4.6, UACR 267 mg/g. <ref id="bp_sys">BP 126/80, HR 70, weight 82.2 kg.</ref>

Albuminuria persists despite ARB, so: <ref id="rx_finerenone">start finerenone 10 mg daily</ref>. K and creatinine in 4 weeks. Return in 3 months.

items.narrative: Phone. K 6 this morning, 5.9 on repeat. <ref id="hold_finerenone">Hold finerenone</ref>; review 3/17.

<ref id="dx_ckd">CKD G3b A3</ref>, <ref id="dx_dm">diabetic</ref> and <ref id="dx_htn">hypertensive</ref>. Feels well, no new complaints.

eGFR 39 today, K 5.2. <ref id="bp_sys">BP 122/80, HR 74, weight 80.7 kg.</ref> Weight down from 82.2 kg in January.

Potassium is mildly high; will watch it with repeat labs. Return in 3 months.
